summary: Located within the heart of the ever-desirable Eastbourne area of Darlington and offered to the market with the added advantage of no onward chain, this spacious two-bedroom semi-detached home presents an excellent opportunity for a wide range of buyers.
description:
Whether you are a first-time purchaser, investor, downsizer or growing family, this well-proportioned property offers comfortable accommodation, generous outdoor space and excellent potential. Ideally positioned close to a wealth of local amenities, the property is within easy reach of well-regarded schools, shops and everyday conveniences. Darlington's mainline railway station, providing direct links along the East Coast Main Line, is just a short distance away, whilst the town centre offers an excellent selection of retail, leisure and dining facilities, making this a highly convenient location for both commuters and families alike. Internally, the property offers spacious accommodation throughout and briefly comprises a welcoming entrance hallway, a comfortable lounge, separate dining room, fitted kitchen and convenient ground floor WC. To the first floor, there are two well-proportioned bedrooms, both offering excellent space, together with a family bathroom. Externally, the property enjoys gardens to both the front and rear, providing pleasant outdoor spaces for relaxing and entertaining during the warmer months. A private driveway offers the added benefit of off-road parking, further enhancing the practicality of this attractive home. Combining generous living accommodation, a sought-after location, gardens, driveway parking and the significant advantage of no onward chain, this delightful property represents an excellent opportunity for both owner-occupiers and investors alike. Early viewing is strongly recommended to fully appreciate the accommodation, potential and convenient setting on offer.

ENTRANCE The property is accessed via a UPVC-framed double-glazed entrance door positioned to the side of the property, opening into a welcoming entrance hallway.

ENTRANCE HALL The hallway provides an excellent first impression of the home and offers access to the principal ground floor accommodation, creating a practical and inviting introduction to this well-proportioned semi-detached property.

LOUNGE A spacious and inviting principal reception room, beautifully presented and offering an excellent space for both everyday family living and entertaining. A large UPVC-framed double-glazed bow window allows an abundance of natural light to flood the room, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere. A contemporary feature fire surround with hearth, incorporating a modern log-effect electric fire, provides an attractive focal point and enhances the room's warm and homely feel. A radiator ensures year-round comfort, whilst the generous proportions allow ample space for a wide range of lounge furniture, making this a relaxing and versatile living space.

DINING ROOM A well-proportioned second reception room, offering a versatile space that is ideally suited for formal dining, family meals or an additional sitting room, depending on individual requirements. Double doors lead seamlessly into the kitchen, creating an excellent flow for both everyday living and entertaining. A useful under-stair storage cupboard provides valuable additional storage, whilst the generous proportions ensure ample space for a family dining table and additional furniture, making this a practical and adaptable reception room.

KITCHEN The kitchen is fitted with a practical range of base and wall units, complemented by laminate work surfaces, providing ample storage and preparation space for everyday living. An inset sink unit with drainer and mixer tap is incorporated within the work surface, whilst integrated appliances include an oven, hob and stainless steel chimney-style extractor. There is designated space for a fridge/freezer, together with plumbing for an automatic washing machine, ensuring the kitchen is well equipped to meet the needs of modern family life. Flooded with natural light from two UPVC-framed double-glazed windows, the room enjoys a bright and airy feel throughout. A UPVC-framed double-glazed door provides direct access to the rear garden, creating a seamless connection between the indoor and outdoor spaces and making this a practical and functional kitchen for everyday use.

GROUND FLOOR WC Conveniently located on the ground floor, the cloakroom is fitted with a white suite comprising a low-level WC and wash hand basin. A UPVC-framed double-glazed window allows natural light and ventilation, whilst a radiator provides warmth and comfort. A useful addition to the home, this practical cloakroom is ideally suited to modern family living and adds further convenience for both residents and visiting guests.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING The first-floor landing provides access to both bedrooms and the family bathroom, together with access to the loft via a convenient pull-down ladder. The loft offers excellent potential for conversion into additional living accommodation, subject to the necessary planning permissions and building regulations, presenting an exciting opportunity for a new owner to further enhance and extend this well-proportioned home.

BEDROOM ONE A generously proportioned double bedroom, offering an abundance of space for a full range of bedroom furniture and furnishings. The room is enhanced by a UPVC-framed double-glazed bow window, allowing natural light to flood the space and creating a bright and airy atmosphere. A radiator provides warmth and comfort, whilst the generous dimensions make this an inviting and relaxing principal bedroom, perfectly suited to modern family living.

BEDROOM TWO A further well-proportioned bedroom, offering versatile accommodation ideal as a guest room, child's bedroom or home office. The room benefits from a UPVC-framed double-glazed window, allowing plenty of natural light to create a bright and welcoming environment. A radiator provides warmth and comfort, whilst the addition of built-in storage and hanging space offers practical wardrobe facilities, maximising the available floor space and enhancing the room's functionality.

FAMILY BATHROOM The family bathroom is fitted with a white suite comprising a panelled bath with a mains-fed rainhead shower over, complemented by a separate handheld attachment for added convenience. A wash hand basin and low-level WC complete the suite. The room benefits from part-tiled walls, providing a practical finish, together with a chrome heated towel radiator for added comfort. A UPVC-framed double-glazed window allows natural light and ventilation, creating a bright and welcoming bathroom ideally suited to modern family living.

EXTERNALLY To the front of the property, there is an attractive wall-enclosed garden, planted with a variety of established shrubs, creating an appealing approach to the home. A private driveway provides the convenience of off-road parking. To the rear, the property enjoys a further enclosed garden, predominantly laid to lawn and complemented by paved patio areas, providing an ideal setting for outdoor dining, entertaining or simply relaxing during the warmer months. The enclosed nature of the garden offers a pleasant degree of privacy, making it a wonderful space for both families and keen gardeners alike.
